Create a new gift code for the authenticated user.

This endpoint creates a gift code that can be shared with others.
The gift code grants 1 year of premium access when redeemed.

Args:
    request: CreateGiftCodeRequest with RevenueCat product and purchase IDs

Returns:
    CreateGiftCodeResponse with the generated gift code

Get all gift codes created by the authenticated user.

This endpoint returns a list of all gift codes the user has created,
including their redemption status.

Returns:
    MyGiftCodesResponse with list of gift codes and counts

Redeem a gift code to receive 1 year of premium access.

The premium access is stacked on top of any existing subscription.
Users cannot redeem their own gift codes.

Args:
    request: RedeemGiftCodeRequest with the gift code

Returns:
    RedeemGiftCodeResponse with success status and message
